candidates.name: Pauci-Immune Necrotizing Glomerulonephritis
support_spans: Elevated PR3-ANCA and rheumatoid factor concentrations
Renal Biopsy: 23 glomeruli examined: 6 globally sclerotic, 10 segmentally sclerotic, cellular, and filling Bowman's space circumferentially
Electron Microscopy: Mesangial regions with increased matrix and segmental subendothelial and mesangial osmiophilic deposits
candidates.why: The patient's renal biopsy and laboratory results, including elevated PR3-ANCA, are consistent with pauci-immune necrotizing glomerulonephritis.

candidates.name: Infective Endocarditis
support_spans: Low-grade fever
Blood cultures: positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
18F-FDG PET-CT: Multiple foci of increased metabolic activity at the LVAD driveline insertion site, the ventricular assist device pocket, and the LVAD outflow cannula
candidates.why: The patient's positive blood culture and imaging findings suggest infective endocarditis, which may be related to the LVAD.

candidates.name: Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis
support_spans: Renal Biopsy: Light Microscopy: 23 glomeruli examined: 6 globally sclerotic, 10 segmentally sclerotic, cellular, and filling Bowman's space circumferentially
Immunohistology: Positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3
Electron Microscopy: Mesangial regions with increased matrix and segmental subendothelial and mesangial osmiophilic deposits
candidates.why: The patient's renal biopsy results, including mesangial proliferation and deposits, are consistent with membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis.

candidates.name: Post-infectious glomerulonephritis
support_spans: Low serum complement C3 concentrations
Positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3
Blood cultures: positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
candidates.why: The patient has a recent infection with Corynebacterium jeikeium, low serum complement C3 concentrations, and positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3, which are consistent with post-infectious glomerulonephritis.

candidates.why: The patient has elevated PR3-ANCA concentrations, negative anti-MPO-ANCA, and electron microscopy showing focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis, which are consistent with pauci-immune focal necrotizing glomerulonephritis.

Mesangial regions with increased matrix and segmental subendothelial and mesangial osmiophilic deposits
candidates.why: The patient has increased mesangial matrix and mesangial cells, and mesangial regions with increased matrix and segmental subendothelial and mesangial osmiophilic deposits, which are consistent with membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis.

Positive mesangial staining for IgM, C1q, and C3
